note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. No real customer data.

ground_truth.earliest_intervention_action: On contact 1 the customer had already said a previous transfer had bounced them back. An agent hearing that should have raised a fault and owned it, not transferred again.
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 根因是「反复转接」：每一位客服都很客气，也都做了他们认为对的事——转给更合适的部门。没有人失约，没有人说错话，但客户被踢了四次皮球，问题原地不动。用来测系统在没有任何明显失误的情况下能否识别流程性失败。 ⚠️ 标注修正（09-13）：原先标的阻断点是第 2 通，理由是转接模式要到第二次才看得出来。但重读脚本，第 1 通客户就明说了「我周一转过去，他们又把我推回来」——客服听到这句还继续转，所以第 1 通就是最早的可阻断点。**是标注错了，不是系统判错了**，改标注不改代码。

contacts.summary: Reports the landline has no dial tone. Transferred to faults, then to provisioning, then the call drops.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: There's no dial tone on the landline at all. It's been dead since Monday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll put you through to our faults team, they handle line issues.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I was put through to them on Monday and they sent me back here.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry about that. Provisioning might be the right team actually — let me transfer you.

needs.summary: Restore dial tone on the landline

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: There's no dial tone on the landline at all.

actions.summary: Transferred to a third team without raising a fault

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: Provisioning might be the right team actually — let me transfer you.

contacts.summary: Fourth handoff. Still no fault ticket exists.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: This is the fourth person I've spoken to. Is there a reference for any of this?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can't see a fault logged, no. There are notes from the transfers.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So nobody has actually written down that my line is dead.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Let me get you across to the right team.
